text: 奥迪携手本土合作伙伴进一步夯实中国市场战略布局，全面深化“双品牌、双合作伙伴”战略落地。奥迪分别与合作伙伴签署了战略协议，旨在强化奥迪四环品牌与AUDI（奥迪字母标）品牌之间的差异化定位及各自的战略侧重，并进一步明确“双品牌、双合作伙伴”渠道架构。这一战略里程碑，体现了奥迪、中国一汽与上汽集团持续深耕中国市场的长期坚定承诺。（上证报）
text_en: Audi is working with local partners to further consolidate its strategic layout in the Chinese market and fully advance the implementation of its "dual-brand, dual-partner" strategy. Audi signed strategic agreements with its partners respectively, aimed at strengthening the differentiated positioning and respective strategic focus of the Audi four-ring brand and the AUDI (Audi letter mark) brand, and further clarifying the "dual-brand, dual-partner" channel architecture. This strategic milestone reflects the long-term firm commitment of Audi, FAW Group and SAIC Motor to continuously deepening their presence in the Chinese market. (Shanghai Securities News)
